title: "Wildfires"
author: "Chloe Mercurio"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
print(length(raw$features))

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
print(names(first_fire))

first_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
print(first_coordinate)

wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)
print(wildfires)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(
    incident,
    stringr::regex("August", ignore_case = TRUE)
  ))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10) |>
  dplyr::select(incident, gis_acres)
```

```{r}
annual_acres <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(fire_year)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(fire_year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot2::ggplot(annual_acres, ggplot2::aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Total Wildfire Acres Burned by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "Source: wildfire incident data"
  )
```
